## Recruitment events
The API posts every event here when `N8N_EVENTS_ENABLED=true`: new candidate, analysis done, recruiter decision...
Applications of the **Application pipeline** workflow are not sent here: that workflow writes their messages itself (acknowledgement, answer after the decision).

The workflow prepares the message to send (acknowledgement, interview invitation, answer after the recruiter's decision — never an automatic rejection) and shows it in the app's notifications.

To really send e-mails: enable the **Send e-mail** node and give it SMTP credentials.
